name: Marblehead
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Marblehead?
answer_short: Yes, if it's titled and plated. On Kelleys Island and in Marblehead, golf carts must pass a police inspection for a title and plate before using public roads, and Marblehead limits them to streets posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.notes: Police inspection for title and plate

rules.rule: Golf carts are motor vehicles in Ohio; police inspect them for title and plates
Inspected, titled and registered carts on streets posted 35 mph or less

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Marblehead?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can my child drive a golf cart in Marblehead?
faq.a: No. Golf carts are motor vehicles in Ohio and need a licensed driver.

faq.q: Can I drink on a golf cart on Kelleys Island?
faq.a: No. The island isn't a DORA district, so open containers aren't allowed on golf carts.
